name: @gpuiv/packager
description: Package GPUIV apps into distributable desktop products (macOS .app, Windows portable exe, Linux tarballs) with bun compile. Requires bun: the CLI and library are TypeScript executed directly.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!process.env.CI) { console.error('Never publish @gpuiv/packager locally. CI is the only release path. See AGENTS.md.'); process.exit(1) }"
